## Service: marketplace (Developer marketplace API v3)

Documentation for Marketplace API

**API Version v3**

All APIs available via `/v3` route prefix with AIP-compliant responses.

### Create a new wallet charge
POST /marketplace/billing/charges
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/marketplace/billing/charges
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/charge | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/charge.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token only (Private Integration Tokens are not accepted). Scopes: charges.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) RaiseChargeBodyDTO:
- appId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - App ID of the App
- meterId* string (e.g. "680b97022b4a34420f5f9b93") - Billing Meter ID (you can find this on your app's pricing page)
- eventId* string (e.g. "evt_abc123") - Event ID / Transaction ID on your server's side. This will help you maintain the reference of the event/transaction on your end that you charged the customer for.
- userId string (e.g. "user_abc123") - User ID
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - ID of the Sub-Account to be charged
- companyId* string (e.g. "company_abc123") - ID of the Agency the Sub-account belongs to
- description* string (e.g. "Charge for sending 10 SMS messages") - Description of the charge
- price number (e.g. 0.01) - Price per unit to charge
- units* number (e.g. 10) - Number of units to charge
- eventTime string (e.g. "2025-03-26T00:00:000Z") - The timestamp when the event/transaction was performed. If blank, the billing timestamp will be set as the event time. ISO8601 Format.

Response 201 (Charge created successfully) application/json:
- success boolean - Indicates whether the charge was created successfully
- chargeId string - Unique identifier of the created charge

Errors: 400, 422 (422: see Common error responses)
Response 400 (Bad request) application/json:
- message string - Error message describing the bad request
- statusCode number - HTTP status code

### Get all wallet charges
GET /marketplace/billing/charges
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/marketplace/billing/charges
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/get-charges | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/get-charges.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token only (Private Integration Tokens are not accepted). Scopes: charges.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- meterId string (e.g. "680b97022b4a34420f5f9b93") - Billing Meter ID (you can find this on your app's pricing page on the developer portal)
- eventId string (e.g. "evt_abc123") - Event ID / Transaction ID
- userId string (e.g. "user_abc123") - Filter results by User ID that your server passed via API when the charge was created
- startDate string (e.g. "2025-03-26") - Filter results AFTER a specific date. Use this in combination with endDate to filter results in a specific time window.
- endDate string (e.g. "2025-03-26") - Filter results BEFORE a specific date. Use this in combination with startDate to filter results in a specific time window.
- skip number (e.g. 0) - Number of records to skip
- limit number (e.g. 10) - Maximum number of records to return

Response 200 (Returns list of wallet charges) application/json:
- charges object[] - List of wallet charges
  - refunded boolean - Value is 'true' if the charge has subsequently been refunded.
  - currency string - Currency of the transaction. We currently support USD only.
  - appId string - App ID
  - meterId string - Billing Meter ID (you can find this on your app's pricing page)
  - chargeId string - Charge ID
  - entityType string - Indicates who was charged? Currently, we support charges for 'location' only
  - entityId string - If the entityType is Location, entityld would be locationld.
  - amountCharged number - Total amount charged
  - pricePerUnit number - Price per unit for the charge
  - transactionType string - This can be one of two values - 'charge' or 'refund'
  - units number - Number of units that the sub-account was charged for
  - meta object - meta object contains details that were sent while creating the charge via the API - eventID, description, eventTime, userld
  - createdAt string (format: date-time) - Timestamp when the charge was created in our system
  - updatedAt string (format: date-time) - Timestamp when the charge was last updated in our system
- count number (deprecated) - Total number of charges
- pagination object - Pagination metadata for the charges list
  - total number - Total number of charges
  - skip number - Number of records to skip
  - limit number - Maximum number of records to return

Errors: 422 (422: see Common error responses)

### Get Installer Details
GET /marketplace/app/{appId}/installations
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/marketplace/app/{appId}/installations
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/get-installer-details | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/get-installer-details.md

Fetches installer details for the authenticated user. This endpoint returns information about the company, location, user, and installation details associated with the current OAuth token.

Auth (any one of):
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token only (Private Integration Tokens are not accepted). Scopes: marketplace-installer-details.readonly
- Agency token: OAuth access token only (Private Integration Tokens are not accepted). Scopes: marketplace-installer-details.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- appId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - ID of the app to get installer details

Response 200 (Successfully retrieved installer details. Returns company, location, user, and installation information.) application/json:
- installationDetails* object - Installation details
  - companyId* string - Company ID
  - locationId string - Location ID (if applicable)
  - companyName* string - Company name
  - relationshipNumber* string - Company relationship number
  - companyEmail string (nullable) - Company email. Will be null for sub-account installations due to PII concerns.
  - companyOwnerFullName string (nullable) - Company owner full name. Will be null for sub-account installations due to PII concerns.
  - userId* string - User ID who installed the app
  - isWhitelabelCompany* boolean - Whether the company is a whitelabel company
  - companyPlan string (nullable) - Company plan. Will be null for sub-account installations due to business sensitivity.
  - companyHighLevelPlan string (nullable; deprecated) - Company plan. Will be null for sub-account installations due to business sensitivity.
  - marketplaceAppPlanId string - Marketplace app plan ID for paid apps
  - whitelabelDetails object - Whitelabel details (only present if isWhitelabelCompany is true)
    - domain* string - Domain of the whitelabel company
    - logoUrl* string - Logo URL of the whitelabel company

Errors: 400, 403
Response 400 (Bad Request. Invalid request parameters or missing required data.): no body
Response 403 (Forbidden. The client does not have necessary permissions to access installer details.): no body

### Migrate external authentication connection
POST /marketplace/external-auth/migration
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/marketplace/external-auth/migration
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/migrate-connection | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/migrate-connection.md

Migrates an external authentication connection credentials (basic or oauth2) for a specific app and location. This endpoint validates the app configuration, stores credentials safely in CRM's native encrypted storage. With this the lifecycle of the token is managed by CRM.

Auth (any one of):
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: marketplace-external-auth-migration.write
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token only (Private Integration Tokens are not accepted). Scopes: marketplace-external-auth-migration.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) MigrateConnectionDto:
- type* string (enum: oauth2 | basic; e.g. "oauth2") - Type of authentication - basic or oauth2
- locationId* string (e.g. "location_12345") - Location ID
- appId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - App ID
- appVersionId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439012") - App Version ID
- accountId* string (e.g. "my-connection-identifier") - Connection identifier
- apiKey string (e.g. "sk_test_1234567890") - API Key (supported when type is basic)
- basicCredentials object - Basic auth credentials as key/value pairs (supported when type is basic). Keys are validated against the app version externalAuthConfig.fields.
- accessToken string (e.g. "ya29.a0AfH6SMBx...") - Access token (required when type is oauth2)
- refreshToken string (e.g. "1//0gHq5F...") - Refresh token. Omit only when the provider issues long-lived, non-refreshable tokens (e.g. TikTok Marketing API, ClickUp) and therefore never returns one. Callers are responsible for supplying it whenever their app has a refresh endpoint configured: the migration stores exactly what it is given and replaces any previously stored secret, so omitting a refresh token the connection needs will leave it unable to refresh once the access token expires. Must be a non-empty string when supplied — null is rejected.
- expiryIn number (e.g. 3600000) - Access token expiry time in milliseconds (optional for oauth2)
- expiryAt number (e.g. 1735689600000) - Timestamp for access token expiry (optional for oauth2)
- scopes string[] (e.g. ["contacts.readonly","contacts.write"]) - OAuth2 scopes (optional for oauth2)
- displayName string (e.g. "My Connection Display Name") - Display name for the connection (optional, defaults to accountId)
- email string (e.g. "user@example.com") - Account email metadata for the migrated connection
- identitySource string (enum: provider | manual; e.g. "manual") - Source of the account identity metadata
- isDefault boolean - Whether this is the default connection for the location (optional, defaults to false)

Response 201 (Connection migrated successfully) application/json:
- success* boolean - Indicates if the migration was successful
- identifier* string - Unique identifier for the migrated connection
- message string - Message describing the result

Errors: 400, 401, 404, 500
Response 400 (Bad request - invalid input or auth type mismatch) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
Response 401 (Unauthorized - invalid or missing token) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
- error string
Response 404 (App not found): no body
Response 500 (Internal server error) application/json:
- statusCode number - HTTP status code
- message string - Error message describing the internal server error

### Uninstall an application
DELETE /marketplace/app/{appId}/installations
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/marketplace/app/{appId}/installations
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/uninstall-application | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/uninstall-application.md

Uninstalls an application from your company or a specific location. This will remove the application`s access and stop all its functionalities

Auth (any one of):
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token only (Private Integration Tokens are not accepted). Scopes: oauth.write
- Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: oauth.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- appId* string (e.g. "674587703dfd4161f1e3c557") - The application id which is to be uninstalled.

Request body (required) (application/json) DeleteIntegrationBodyDto:
- companyId string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - The company id from which the application is to be uninstalled. If you pass agency token, then companyId is required. It will uninstall application from agency as well as all sub-accounts.
- locationId string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - The location id from which the application is to be uninstalled. If you pass location token, then locationId is required. It will uninstall application from that location only.
- reason string (e.g. "Application is not working as expected") - The reason for uninstalling the application. Reason is required if you are uninstalling the application as a developer.

Response 200 (Successfully uninstalled the application) application/json:
- success* boolean - The status of the uninstallation of the application

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
